name: Palladous-Playa
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a tidally locked hemisphere, and everything the light never reaches.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Leviathan fauna breach the sea-mist at dusk, singing on frequencies felt in the teeth.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in biomass here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
